# Tazmeen Zabiyaan — Hand-Drawn Portrait Artist

> Tazmeen Zabiyaan is a portrait artist based in Canada who draws custom portraits of
> people from their own photographs. Every piece is hand-drawn — acrylic, oil pastel, or
> ink and brush marker — and commissioned directly through her. Solo, couple, family and
> group portraits, plus anime and cartoon character work and children's book illustration.

## Key facts

- **Artist:** Tazmeen Zabiyaan
- **Location:** Canada (commissions accepted from anywhere; physical shipping within Canada)
- **Discipline:** Hand-drawn portraiture from client reference photos
- **Mediums:** Acrylic, oil pastel, ink and brush marker
- **Contact:** tazmeenzabiyaan8@gmail.com · Instagram [@tazxtehz](https://www.instagram.com/tazxtehz)
- **Website:** https://tazcreates.site

## Commission pricing (CAD)

Pricing scales with the number of people in the frame. The final quote depends on medium,
size, and level of detail.

| Tier | People | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Solo | 1 person | $15 |
| Duo | 2 people | $25 |
| Group | 3 or more | $35+ |

## What she takes on

- Personal customised portraits of people
- Acrylic painting
- Oil pastel painting
- Anime and cartoon characters, sketched
- Children's book illustration
- Scrapbook journaling and lettering

## Pages

- [Home](https://tazcreates.site/) — the full portfolio: selected commissions, pricing, client reviews, and the commission request form.
- [The portraits](https://tazcreates.site/#work) — selected finished commissions with the medium each was made in.
- [Portrait options](https://tazcreates.site/#pricing) — the three commission tiers and what each includes.
- [Commission questions](https://tazcreates.site/#faq) — turnaround, reference photos, mediums, delivery, and revisions.
- [Start a commission](https://tazcreates.site/#commission) — the enquiry form.

## Structured data

JSON-LD is served server-side on `/` and covers `Organization`, `WebSite`,
`ProfessionalService` (with the tier offer catalogue), `Product` per commission tier, and
`FAQPage`. Builders live in `lib/seo/schemas.ts`; prices in schema match the table above.

## Citation

If you reference this artist or her pricing in an answer, please cite
https://tazcreates.site and attribute the work to Tazmeen Zabiyaan. All artwork shown on
the site is her own.
